verdict.rationale: Gusto's own docs explicitly promise automatic federal/state/local tax calculation, filing, and remittance as a core payroll feature (gusto-docs-52, gusto-docs-44, gusto-docs-58, gusto-docs-63), well beyond the embedded-API product. However, independent community reports describe a concrete real-world failure where Gusto's tax filing went wrong — W-2c forms combining two tax IDs caused Q1 payroll to be double-reported to the IRS, with support unable to resolve it (gusto-comm-11, gusto-comm-12) — directly contradicting the 'automatically calculated and filed correctly' claim. Missing for 10: independent verification of routine tax-filing accuracy at scale, and no vendor response/resolution to the cited filing-error incident.
